001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.bar.events.historian;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Random;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.bar.events.historian.HistorianData.HistorianOffer;
007
008public class DonationOfferCreator extends BaseHistorianOfferCreator {
009
010        @Override
011        public HistorianOffer createOffer(Random random, List<HistorianOffer> soFar) {
012                HistorianData hd = HistorianData.getInstance();
013                
014                if (hd.isRecentlyDonated() || hd.isMaxTier()) return null;
015                
016                return new DonationOffer();
017        }
018
019        @Override
020        public boolean ignoresLimit() {
021                return true;
022        }
023        
024        
025}
